summary: **Last Transmission** is an educational 3D space exploration game where players travel across the Moon and Mars to discover and recover 12 scientific artifacts. The main objective is to explore both planets, find six artifacts on the Moon and six on Mars, learn about real space missions and scientific discoveries, and overcome environmental challenges. Once all the artifacts have been collected, players must complete their final journey back to Earth to finish the mission. The game combines adventure, exploration, and science to make learning about space fun and interactive.
details: Last Transmission is an educational 3D space exploration game where players travel across the Moon and Mars to discover and collect 12 scientific artifacts inspired by real NASA missions. Players must explore both planets, overcome environmental challenges such as Martian sandstorms, and complete their mission by returning to Earth. Developed using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, the game combines interactive gameplay, scientific research, and immersive environments to make learning about space fun and accessible. Its goal is to inspire curiosity, promote scientific knowledge, and demonstrate how technology and creativity can transform education.
